revisions.intent: edit existing background; raise the horizon so upper-row Godot dinosaurs stand on land
revisions.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the existing ancient plain background, keeping its bright painted prehistoric style, warm ochre soil, greens, soft sunny light, distant blue mountains, ferns/cycads and natural ground detail. Use a gently elevated downward-looking view with the land/sky horizon about 10-12% from the top; keep sky and distant mountains inside the top 15%. From y=18% to the bottom, show continuous walkable terrestrial plain across the full width, including x=18%,50%,82% and y=25%,50%,75%. Put any retained river in the very distant upper band, away from playable positions. Change only the composition/horizon needed to support upper-row dinosaurs on ground. No dinosaurs, animals, people, bones, buildings, interface elements, markers, labels, text, logos, borders, watermarks or transparency. Output 1536x1024 landscape 3:2.
